---
title: "Learning Guides"
toc: false
---

How to learn a subject and how to read what you find. Practices that come up
often enough to be written down once, as opposed to methods or code.

Checklists and cheat sheets for the modelling work itself are on the
[Pharmacometrics Tools](../pmx-tools.qmd) page.

- [Reading Papers](reading-papers.qmd). A three-pass method for reading a
  paper, what each pass costs in time, and how to stop early when you are
  reading with a question in hand.
- [Effective Learning](effective-learning.qmd). A checklist for learning a new
  skill or discipline: aspiration, broad overview, consulting experts,
  deconstruction, routine, feedback and growth.
